### TAG-143: Example 12.2 Expressing a single return to place of invocation

**Status:** ✅ Implemented

## Software Notes

[TAG-110](https://linear.app/taguniversal/issue/TAG-110/1234-abbreviated-forms-of-the-invocation-and-definition)

## Reference

Single Return to Place of Invocation

If an invocation receives a single result in its own place there is no need of a source list. The corresponding definition can express the single return with the absence of a destination list and with the presence of a single unnamed source place in the place of resolution.   This abbreviation supports the familiar expressional form of functional nesting. 

```
// linear: TAG-143 Expressing a single return to place of invocation
AND($A $B)
AND[(X<>Y<>)
<$X$Y()>
:
   0,0[0]
   0,1[0]
   1,1[1]
   1,0[0]
]
```
